analysis: Exploratory paired synthetic-blur sensitivity on the AZH training pool
retrospective_status: Designed after the original pilot and training-pool results were visible; not preregistered.
test_archive_used: Read for exact deduplication only; no original-test predictions scored.

audit.dimension_flag: long side >700 px or short side >525 px, before fixed resize

protocol.training: All classifiers, temperature and selectors fitted on clean inner data once per fold.
protocol.matched_coverage: Top ceil(coverage * n) scores re-ranked separately in each fold and condition.
protocol.fixed_threshold: Cutoff set from clean calibration-set scores and frozen across held-out conditions; ties may increase retention.
protocol.limitations: Synthetic blur; image-level CV; unknown patient overlap; no clinical validation.
